investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Stonepine Telecom (mobile operator); Platform: Google Cloud southamerica-east1 (zones southamerica-east1-a/southamerica-east1-b/southamerica-east1-c); network range 10.34.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster stonep-prod-southa (GKE); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic sim-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer sim-provisioning, consumer topup-api; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
